topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Oh my gosh, can you believe this? I was rummaging through all this old stuff and there, right in front of me, was my teddy bear from when I was a kid. It's got that same worn-out ear and the button eye I somehow managed to rip out years ago. I mean, what are the odds? I couldn’t just leave it there, right? I’ve got to take it home, like, it’s a piece of my childhood calling out to me.🔍 Teddy’s a bit dusty and definitely needs a good wash, but still, I can’t help but feel all warm and fuzzy inside, like I’m hugging a piece of my past.
